news.conclusionEn: Democrats swept the 2026 midterms, flipping both the House and the Senate and taking control of Congress for the last two years of Trump's term.
news.conclusionZh: 民主党中期选举大胜，同时夺回参众两院控制权。
news.whyEn: Unified Republican control of Washington is over, so Trump's agenda on spending, tariffs, energy, AI and the Iran war now faces a Democratic Congress.
news.whyZh: 共和党全面执政结束，特朗普的财政、关税、AI和伊朗政策都将受国会制衡。
news.detailEn: CNBC projects Democrats will hold at least 250 House seats and at least 54 Senate seats, a far bigger margin than most forecasts. Notable wins include James Talarico's Texas Senate seat, Gina Hinojosa as Texas governor and Keisha Lance Bottoms as Georgia's first Black woman governor, while Democrats also flipped governorships in Ohio, Iowa and Nevada. Trump told CNBC he can work with Democrats on 'financial ideas' but not on an 'open border.' Expect fights over budgets, the debt ceiling and oversight investigations in 2027.
news.detailZh: CNBC预计民主党在众议院至少拿下250席、参议院至少54席，优势远超多数预测。塔拉里科赢得得州参议院席位，伊诺霍萨当选得州州长，兰斯·博托姆斯成为佐治亚州首位黑人女州长，民主党还拿下俄亥俄、爱荷华和内华达州长。特朗普对CNBC表示可以在「财经议题」上与民主党合作，但边境问题不行。2027年预算、债务上限和国会调查料将成为角力焦点。

news.titleEn: Stocks rally as Trump accepts Democratic midterm sweep
news.conclusionEn: U.S. stocks jumped on Wednesday, with the Dow up more than 1,500 points (about 3%), after Trump accepted the Democratic victory and removed fears of a contested result.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普接受败选结果，道指大涨逾1500点、约3%。
news.whyEn: Markets had priced in risk of legal challenges to the vote; a clean outcome plus falling oil lifted almost every asset class tied to U.S. growth.
news.whyZh: 市场原本担心选举结果遭法律挑战，结果明朗加上油价暴跌令美股全面受益。
news.detailEn: The Dow posted its best day since April 2025, while the S&P 500 rose about 1.6% and the Nasdaq about 1.4%. Before the election, a CNBC survey showed 63% of fund managers and economists saw legal challenges as at least some risk to markets. Analysts say Trump's conciliatory tone was the key trigger, though some warn he remains an 'X factor' who could change course. A few strategists now see the S&P 500 reaching 8,000 by year-end if the cooperative tone holds.
news.detailZh: 道指录得2025年4月以来最佳单日表现，标普500涨约1.6%，纳指涨约1.4%。选前CNBC调查显示，63%的基金经理和经济学家认为选举结果遭挑战对市场构成一定风险。分析人士认为特朗普的和解态度是关键催化剂，但也提醒他仍是「变数」，随时可能转向。部分策略师认为若合作氛围持续，标普500年底有望冲上8000点。

news.titleEn: Oil prices drop below $100 as midterms fuel hope for an end to the Iran war
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude fell more than 8% to below $100 a barrel for the first time since Oct. 7, its biggest one-day drop since April.
news.conclusionZh: 布伦特原油单日暴跌逾8%，自10月7日来首次跌破100美元。
news.whyEn: Cheaper oil eases inflation and fuel costs worldwide; traders bet the election loss will push the White House to find an exit from the Iran war.
news.whyZh: 油价回落缓解全球通胀和燃油成本，市场押注选举失利将迫使白宫结束伊朗战争。
news.detailEn: WTI also dropped about 8.3% to roughly $88 a barrel, after Brent traded as high as $118 just days earlier. Vice President JD Vance posted that the Iran war drove Republican losses, and Trump admitted voters were not willing to accept higher gasoline prices. The war, launched on Feb. 28, had pushed U.S. gasoline prices up 39%, and analysts now expect the national average to fall below $4. Diesel futures dropped nearly 7%, which could ease transport and grocery costs.
news.detailZh: WTI原油同样下跌约8.3%至约88美元，而几天前布伦特还一度高达118美元。副总统万斯发文称伊朗战争是共和党失利主因，特朗普也承认选民不愿承受油价上涨。这场2月28日爆发的战争曾令美国汽油价格上涨39%，分析师预计全国均价将跌破4美元。柴油期货跌近7%，有望降低运输和食品成本。

news.titleEn: AI data center stocks and Musk's SpaceX decline as Texas governor result raises risks of a slowdown
news.conclusionEn: Chip, data-center and Musk-linked stocks fell after Democrat Gina Hinojosa, who promised a moratorium on new data centers, won the Texas governor's race.
news.conclusionZh: 承诺暂停新建数据中心的民主党人赢得得州州长，AI基建股下挫。
news.whyEn: Texas holds about 27% of planned U.S. data-center capacity, so tighter local rules could slow the AI build-out that chipmakers and data-center operators depend on.
news.whyZh: 得州占美国规划数据中心容量约27%，监管收紧将拖慢AI基建，冲击芯片和算力公司。
news.detailEn: SpaceX fell about 4% and Tesla about 5% after the open, while CoreWeave slid and Nvidia drifted lower as the chip index fell roughly 3%. Big cloud spenders moved the other way, with Microsoft up more than 5%, as investors bet slower build-outs would ease their huge capital spending. Democrats also won governorships in Georgia, Pennsylvania and Ohio, states that together host about 17% of planned capacity. Strategists warn local officials now see political upside in blocking or delaying data centers.
news.detailZh: 开盘后SpaceX跌约4%，特斯拉跌约5%，CoreWeave走低，英伟达小跌，费城半导体指数跌约3%。大型云厂商反而上涨，微软涨超5%，投资者认为基建放缓可减轻其巨额资本开支。民主党还赢得佐治亚、宾州和俄亥俄州长，这三州合计占规划容量约17%。策略师警告，地方官员如今会发现阻挠或拖延数据中心项目在政治上有利可图。

news.titleEn: Trump threatens to 'finish the job' if Iran rejects nuclear deal as IRGC vows 'united' resistance
news.conclusionEn: Trump warned he could 'finish the job very easily' if Iran refuses a binding nuclear deal, while Tehran's leaders rejected what they called demands for surrender.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普警告伊朗不签核协议就「收尾」，伊朗方面拒绝「投降式」要求。
news.whyEn: Oil has just priced in hopes of peace; any breakdown in talks or new strikes could quickly reverse that and hit energy markets and shipping again.
news.whyZh: 油价刚计入和平预期，一旦谈判破裂或再起战火，能源和航运市场将再受冲击。
news.detailEn: Trump said that if Iran behaves 'we can sign something up,' while both he and Vance acknowledged the war contributed to Republican midterm losses. Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said Washington wants 'the surrender of the Iranian nation,' and IRGC Quds Force commander Esmaeil Qaani said allied forces were united across the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb. Indirect talks through Qatari mediators have continued in Doha, but both sides remain far apart. The next few days of diplomacy will be closely watched by oil traders.
news.detailZh: 特朗普称伊朗若「守规矩」就可以签协议，他和万斯都承认战争拖累了共和党选情。伊朗最高领袖穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊称美国要的是「伊朗民族的投降」，革命卫队圣城旅指挥官卡尼称盟友力量已在霍尔木兹海峡和曼德海峡一线形成统一阵线。通过卡塔尔斡旋的间接谈判仍在多哈进行，但双方立场差距仍大。未来几天的外交进展将是油市焦点。

news.titleEn: China Confirms Talks With Russia, US on First Trilateral Meeting
news.conclusionEn: China said it is in contact with the U.S. and Russia about a possible Xi-Trump-Putin meeting at this month's APEC summit in Shenzhen.
news.conclusionZh: 中方确认正与美俄沟通，或在深圳APEC峰会举行三国元首会晤。
news.whyEn: A first-ever three-way summit of the largest nuclear powers could shape the Ukraine war, trade tensions and global security.
news.whyZh: 三大核大国首次元首会晤，可能影响俄乌战局、贸易摩擦和全球安全格局。
news.detailEn: Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning confirmed the contacts on Nov. 4, after weeks of silence from Beijing. The APEC summit is scheduled for Nov. 18-19 in Shenzhen, and both Trump and Putin have already said they are interested in a sit-down with Xi. Such a meeting could let Xi play mediator between Washington and Moscow. Separately, U.S., Russian and Ukrainian negotiators are due to meet in Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10-11.
news.detailZh: 外交部发言人毛宁11月4日确认了相关沟通，此前北京对此沉默数周。APEC峰会定于11月18日至19日在深圳举行，特朗普和普京都已公开表示有意与习近平会面。这样的会晤可能让中方在美俄之间扮演调解角色。另外，美俄乌三方谈判代表定于11月10日至11日在阿布扎比会面。

news.titleEn: Stocks making the biggest moves after hours: Coherent, AppLovin, Expedia, Qualcomm and more
news.conclusionEn: AppLovin soared more than 20% after a strong quarter, while Qualcomm, Expedia, Zillow and Dutch Bros fell on weak guidance or misses.
news.conclusionZh: AppLovin财报亮眼盘后涨超20%，高通、Expedia等因指引疲弱下跌。
news.whyEn: Earnings guidance is driving big single-stock swings, showing investors reward ad-tech AI winners but punish any sign of slowing growth.
news.whyZh: 业绩指引引发个股大幅波动：AI广告赢家受追捧，增长放缓迹象则遭重罚。
news.detailEn: AppLovin's revenue of $2.18 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $1.84 billion both beat forecasts. Qualcomm fell about 6% despite a small earnings beat because its next-quarter EPS guidance of $2.15-$2.35 had a midpoint below estimates. Expedia dropped over 7% on soft fourth-quarter revenue guidance, Zillow sank 16% after missing on earnings and revenue, and Dutch Bros fell 19% after trimming its EBITDA outlook. Coherent and e.l.f. Beauty rose after beating estimates.
news.detailZh: AppLovin营收21.8亿美元、调整后EBITDA 18.4亿美元，均超预期。高通虽小幅超预期，但下季度每股收益指引2.15-2.35美元的中值低于预期，股价跌约6%。Expedia因第四季度营收指引偏弱跌超7%，Zillow营收和利润双双不及预期跌16%，Dutch Bros下调EBITDA指引后跌19%。Coherent和e.l.f. Beauty则因业绩超预期上涨。

news.titleEn: More than 50 trapped under rubble after Russian strike on school-turned-aid centre, Zelenskyy says
news.conclusionEn: A Russian strike on a former school used as an aid centre in southeastern Ukraine killed at least 33 people, with more than 50 feared trapped.
news.conclusionZh: 俄军空袭乌东南部援助点，至少33人遇难，逾50人被困。
news.whyEn: The attack, hours after a short ceasefire ended, clouds hopes for the U.S.-led three-way peace talks set for Abu Dhabi next week.
news.whyZh: 袭击发生在短暂停火结束后数小时，给下周阿布扎比三方和谈蒙上阴影。
news.detailEn: The strike hit the frontline village of Komyshuvakha, where the building handed out humanitarian aid every Monday. Zelenskyy called it one of the largest Russian killings of the war, and the UN monitoring mission said Russia either knew about the aid distribution or failed to take basic steps to find out. A separate strike on a Kharkiv hospital wounded dozens. U.S., Russian and Ukrainian negotiators are still scheduled to meet in Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10-11.
news.detailZh: 遭袭地点是前线村庄科米舒瓦哈，该建筑每周一发放人道援助。泽连斯基称这是战争以来俄方最严重的屠杀之一，联合国监察团表示俄方要么知道当地在发放援助，要么连最基本的核查都没做。另一次针对哈尔科夫医院的袭击造成数十人受伤。美俄乌三方谈判代表仍计划于11月10日至11日在阿布扎比会面。

news.titleEn: Asian stocks and dollar fall as Democrats gain ground in US midterms
news.conclusionEn: Asian markets fell on Wednesday as Democratic gains raised worries about tighter AI regulation, with Japan's Nikkei down 2.85% and Taiwan's Taiex down 2.3%.
news.conclusionZh: 民主党选情领先引发AI监管担忧，日股跌2.85%、台股跌2.3%。
news.whyEn: Asia's chip-heavy markets are highly exposed to U.S. AI spending, so any threat to the data-center boom hits Japan, Taiwan and South Korea first.
news.whyZh: 亚洲股市高度依赖美国AI投资，数据中心热潮一旦受阻，日韩台首当其冲。
news.detailEn: South Korea's Kospi lost 1.17% and Australia's ASX 200 fell 0.8%, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng edged up. The dollar weakened, with the yen strengthening to about 157.6 per dollar and the pound rising 0.4%, and gold gained about 0.5%. Analysts warned of possible legislative gridlock, fiscal brinkmanship and debt-ceiling fights ahead. Asian markets partly recovered the next morning after Wall Street's rally, though chip-heavy Korea lagged.
news.detailZh: 韩国综合指数跌1.17%，澳洲ASX 200跌0.8%，恒生指数小涨。美元走弱，日元升至约157.6兑1美元，英镑涨0.4%，黄金涨约0.5%。分析人士警告未来可能出现立法僵局、财政边缘政策和债务上限之争。随着华尔街大涨，亚洲股市次日早盘部分回升，但芯片权重高的韩股仍落后。

businessTips.explanationEn: Opportunity cost is the value of the best alternative you give up when you make a choice. Every hour, dollar or team you commit to one project cannot be used elsewhere. Thinking in opportunity costs forces you to compare options against each other, not just against doing nothing. It is one of the simplest ways to avoid 'busy but not productive' decisions.
businessTips.explanationZh: 机会成本是指做出一个选择时所放弃的最佳替代方案的价值。投入到一个项目里的每一小时、每一块钱、每一个人，都不能再用在别处。用机会成本思考，会逼你把各个选项互相比较，而不只是和「什么都不做」比较。这是避免「很忙但没产出」最简单的方法之一。
businessTips.exampleEn: A manager deciding whether to spend three months building an internal tool should ask what else that engineering team could ship in those three months. If a customer-facing feature could add more revenue, the tool's true cost is that lost revenue, not just salaries.
businessTips.exampleZh: 经理在决定是否花三个月开发内部工具时，应该问：这支团队这三个月还能做出什么？如果做一个面向客户的功能能带来更多收入，那么这个工具的真实成本就是那部分错失的收入，而不只是工资。

businessTips.explanationEn: Unit economics measures the revenue and costs tied to a single unit, such as one order, one customer or one subscription. If each unit loses money, growing faster only makes losses bigger. Key numbers include price, variable cost per unit, contribution margin and customer acquisition cost. Getting unit economics right early tells you whether a side hustle can scale profitably.
businessTips.explanationZh: 单位经济模型衡量的是单个单位（一笔订单、一个客户或一份订阅）带来的收入和成本。如果每个单位都在亏钱，增长越快亏得越多。关键数字包括售价、单位可变成本、边际贡献和获客成本。尽早算清单位经济，就能判断一个副业能否盈利地放大。
businessTips.exampleEn: Someone selling candles online at $30 might pay $9 for materials, $8 for shipping and packaging, $3 in platform fees and $6 in ads per sale. That leaves only $4 per candle, so they may need a higher price or bundles before spending more on ads.
businessTips.exampleZh: 网上卖蜡烛的人售价30美元，每单材料9美元、运费包装8美元、平台费3美元、广告6美元，最后每支只剩4美元。在加大广告投放之前，可能需要先提价或做组合套装。

businessTips.explanationEn: A spin-off is when a company separates a business unit into a new, independently listed company and gives its shares to existing shareholders. Management usually argues that focused companies are easier to run and value than conglomerates. Spin-offs are often structured to be tax-free and can take a year or more to complete. In the short term, the parent's stock can fall if investors worry about costs, debt allocation or execution risk.
businessTips.explanationZh: 分拆是指公司把某个业务独立出来成立新的上市公司，并把新公司股份分给现有股东。管理层通常认为业务更聚焦的公司比综合集团更好管理、也更容易估值。分拆一般设计为免税，往往需要一年以上才能完成。短期内，如果投资者担心分拆成本、债务分配或执行风险，母公司股价可能下跌。
businessTips.exampleEn: CVS Health plans to split into a healthcare solutions company (Aetna, Caremark) and a retail pharmacy company by 2028, with shareholders owning shares in both. Investors then need to value each business separately and decide which one fits their portfolio.
businessTips.exampleZh: CVS Health计划在2028年前拆分为医疗解决方案公司（Aetna、Caremark）和零售药房公司，股东将同时持有两家公司的股票。投资者届时需要分别评估两块业务的价值，再决定哪家更适合自己的投资组合。
